_README: The training charter (#5068, epic #5067): the ONE source of every training target the engine, the critics, the coaches and the skills read. HAND-OWNED (deploy/config_ownership_audit.py); any change needs an owner ruling and a change_log entry. This file is PUBLIC. The owner-only twin (body/appearance targets) is never committed — see config/training_charter.private.example.json and lambdas/training/training_charter.py. Published surfaces read ONLY training_charter.public_view() (the PUBLISHED_WHITELIST); the target date and the rate band are not on it (owner ruling 2026-10-18: no May countdown or May target on the site). ADR-164.

change_log.what: First charter: the frame, the rate band, the 5-day split, the step floor and target, the cardio menu, no scheduled deload, effort ceilings, rotation cadence, gated movements, the concession ledger.
change_log.rule: any change needs an owner ruling; bump `version` and add a line here

change_log.by: the owner's double-progression ruling (#4503 OD5, 2026-09-30), moved here from owner_redlines.REDLINES['lifting_sessions_per_wk']['gain_rule'] (#5052)
change_log.what: Added `progression`: the gain rule (two top-of-range exposures at or under the effort ceiling earn one 5-lb step, reps back to the bottom) and the self-raised-load rule (a load the owner raised himself at or under the ceiling becomes the next floor and is graded progressed, not a breach). The redline copy is retired; the engine reads it here.
change_log.rule: any change needs an owner ruling; bump `version` and add a line here

change_log.by: owner ruling 2026-10-18 on #5088 (a late-December trip: travel templates, steps held, 2-3 short sessions a week, step back up on return)
change_log.what: Adds split.minimum_session (the 20-minute minimum per role: anchors only, top set + one back-off) and the disruption block (an owner-switched mode that holds habits instead of targets, its travel/busy templates, the step-back-up week and when the coach OFFERS the mode).
change_log.rule: any change needs an owner ruling; bump `version` and add a line here

change_log.by: the owner-requested elite-panel training review 2026-10-18 (#5057): calf press, leg press and DB curl held the same load x reps for weeks at an easy self-reported RPE
change_log.what: Adds progression.stall_rule: the same top-set load x reps on 3 consecutive same-type exposures, each at self-reported RPE 8 or lower, is `step_due` (the prescription's failure to progress, not his) and the next draft carries one step: up to 2 more reps below the top of the range, else the gain rule's load step.
change_log.rule: any change needs an owner ruling; bump `version` and add a line here

governing_goal.mentality: time-bound, must-hit: every expert school is synthesized and each concedes something to the deadline (see concession_ledger)

rate_band_lb_per_wk.note: always shown in lb AND as a percent of bodyweight

governing_goal.precedence: the owner clinical guidance record (USER#matthew#SOURCE#clinical, GUIDANCE#current) outranks the rate band wherever the two conflict; it is reference context, never a gate on intensity

phase_after_may.frame: toward the long-term goal and maintenance — the frame does not end at the target date
phase_after_may.rule: the charter is re-versioned on an owner ruling before the target date, not after it

minimum_session.shape: anchors only, top set + one back-off
minimum_session.from: owner_redlines lifting_sessions_per_wk.minimum_viable_session, tightened to 20 minutes for disruption weeks (#5088)

split.rule: the next session is the one after the last performed lift, whatever the date

ramp.held_by: a lower-leg strain flag holds the ramp at its current level

steps.note: walking carries the volume; gym cardio is deliberate, from the menu

cardio_menu.progression: same RPE at a higher level

intervals.note: RPE 8 on the hard minutes; open by RPE / talk test

deload.note: fatigue signals become a recommendation; a deload happens only on his recorded word (owner ruling 2026-10-18)

effort_ceilings.overage_rule: within +1 RPE of the ceiling is not a breach

ceiling_change_proposal.when: a ceiling is beaten on more than 50% of sets two weeks running
ceiling_change_proposal.effect: proposes a ceiling change (an owner ruling applies it)

gain_rule.trigger: the top of the slot's rep range on the top set of 2 consecutive same-type exposures (heavy -> heavy, volume -> volume), each logged at or under the movement's effort ceiling
gain_rule.size: +2.5 % of the load in whole 5-lb steps, never less than one 5-lb step; reps back to the bottom of the range
gain_rule.rpe_role: veto only — a top-of-range set logged above the movement's effort ceiling (or with no RPE logged) does not count toward the trigger
refused_when: the week after a rate-over-cap flag
the first three exposures of a novel-again pattern

self_raised_load.rule: a load the owner raised himself, logged at or under the movement's effort ceiling (an overage within `effort_ceilings.overage_tolerance_rpe` is not a breach), becomes the next floor and is graded `progressed` — a named state, never folded into an adherence percentage
self_raised_load.above_the_ceiling: a raised load logged above the ceiling plus the tolerance is a breach and never becomes a floor

ceiling_tier.compounds: the low end of `effort_ceilings.by_experience_tier.compounds_rpe` until #5058 assigns the owner's tier
ceiling_tier.last_isolation_set: the low end of `effort_ceilings.by_experience_tier.last_isolation_set_rpe`; an isolation movement's earlier sets read the compounds band

stall_rule.rpe_basis: self-reported: the RPE he logged on the top set (the first working set at the session's heaviest load); an unlogged RPE is not evidence
stall_rule.trigger: the top set's load and reps are identical on the last 3 consecutive same-type exposures, each logged at RPE 8 or lower
stall_rule.step: below the top of the slot's rep range: up to `rep_step_max` more reps at the same load, never past the top; at the top of the range (or with no range on file): the gain rule's load step (`gain_rule.step_pct` in whole `gain_rule.step_lb` steps), reps back to the bottom
stall_rule.not_a_stall: step_due is the prescription's failure to progress, not his: it never fires when he fell short of a prescription on file, and it never fires under a refusal (re-entry, a deload the owner applied)
stall_rule.precedence: after the gain rule's step; before a floor raise (repeating the same load is what it ends)

prerequisites: Stage 4 of the run/walk on-ramp completed

lower_leg_prep.note: the carve-out is limited to the list; everything else plyometric stays excluded

equipment.assumed: full commercial club — machines, cables, plate-loaded, T-bar, dumbbells to heavy, kettlebells, sled, full cardio deck
equipment.rule: the club is never named in this repo

travel.rule: travel templates by mid-December; no calendar blocking

disruption.rule: the owner switches the mode on and off; the coach OFFERS it and never applies it (owner ruling 2026-10-18, #5088)

travel.note: a resort/hotel gym first, bodyweight when there is none

busy.note: the 20-minute minimum at the usual club

step_back_up.serves: the minimum session at the club

nippard.concedes: a faster deficit than it would pick

rp_israetel.concedes: no scheduled deload and legs at maintenance
rp_israetel.in_return: rising volume on shoulders, lats and upper chest plus MEV floors

sbs_nuckols.in_return: coded progression and strength tracking that catches muscle loss early

galpin.in_return: weekly fatigue flags and a real hard/easy cardio split

dan_john.concedes: machines and isolation in the mix

hollywood_transformation_trainer.in_return: gets the frame, the deadline, the steps and the session length

clinical_exercise_physiologist.in_return: weekly strength, sleep and fat-free-mass tracking, effort by RPE

panel_target.rule: every seat scores at least 9/10 with its concession named
